2018 Q4.bq: In quarter four, sales excluding exchange impacts came in slightly above the midpoint of our guidance.

2019 Q2.gq: We went into the EBITDA plan of 90 million, 1-9-0, and now our outlook has been reduced to 150 million.

2026 Q1.bq: For the first quarter, we are reporting revenue of $839 million above our guidance range of $800 million to $830 million 4.8% higher than the fourth quarter, and 17.3% higher than last year's first quarter.

2026 Q3.bq: For the third quarter, we are reporting revenue of $979 million, exceeding the top end of our guidance range, $945 million-$975 million.
